# Flarize — Solar Panel Installation in Kerala

> Flarize Technologies Private Limited is a Kerala-based solar EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) company that installs solar power systems for homes and businesses across Kerala. Flarize handles the complete process: system design, panel installation, KSEB net metering registration, and PM Surya Ghar government subsidy applications.

## About Flarize

Flarize is a trusted solar installation company in Kerala, India. Founded to help Kerala homeowners and businesses reduce their electricity bills through clean solar energy. Flarize offers end-to-end solar solutions — from consultation and design to installation, KSEB approval, and after-sales support.

## Services

- Residential solar panel installation (1kW to 10kW systems)
- Commercial solar panel installation (10kW to 500kW+)
- Industrial solar power systems
- KSEB net metering registration and approvals
- PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana subsidy assistance
- Solar system maintenance and AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract)
- Solar panel cleaning and inspection
- On-grid, off-grid, and hybrid solar systems

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is the cost of solar panel installation in Kerala?
A: The cost varies based on system size. Typically ₹40,000–₹60,000 per kW for residential systems after PM Surya Ghar subsidy. Contact Flarize for a free site assessment.

Q: Is solar power worth it in Kerala?
A: Yes. With high KSEB tariffs and good solar irradiance, most Kerala homeowners see payback within 4–6 years and save significantly on monthly electricity bills.

Q: What is KSEB net metering?
A: KSEB net metering allows solar system owners to feed excess electricity back to the grid and receive credits, reducing their KSEB bill to near zero.

Q: What is PM Surya Ghar subsidy?
A: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana is a central government scheme offering subsidies up to ₹78,000 for residential rooftop solar installations. Flarize assists with the complete application process.

Q: Does Flarize serve commercial customers?
A: Yes. Flarize installs commercial solar systems for shops, factories, apartments, and businesses across Kerala.
